#/texts/3.full_gt_text:
Subject: Representation for pay fixation in the light of IPS (Pay) Amendment
Rules, 2023 - reg.

#/texts/4.label: paragraph
#/texts/4.full_gt_text:
The undersigned is directed to refer to Ministry of Home Affairs' OM No.
16011/07/2024-IPS-II dated 19.05.2026, vide which, the request has been made to
relax the prescribed time limit for exercising the option and provide another
opportunity to IPS officers who want to re-exercise the option for pay fixation in
light of IPS(Pay) Amendment Rules, 2023 notified on 05.12.2023, as a special
case.

#/texts/5.label: paragraph
#/texts/5.full_gt_text: 2. The matter has been examined in this Department in light ofthe extant provisions and reasons/circumstances furnished by MHA. Accordingly, it has been decided to grant a further one-time extension of three months from the date of issuance of this Office Memorandum for exercising/re-exercising the option for pay fixation under the IPS (Pay) Amendment Rules, 2023 in respect of the concerned IPS officers. It is further conveyed that no further request for extension of time or relaxation of conditions for exercising/re-exercising the option shall be entertained under any circumstances. Accordingly, MHA may take further necessary action in the matter.

#/texts/6.label: paragraph
#/texts/6.full_gt_text: 3. This issues with the approval of the competent authority.
